title: Vintage 1979 Holly Hobbie "A Mother's Love" Limited Edition Porcelain Figurine
descriptionText: This vintage 1979 Holly Hobbie "A Mother's Love" figurine is a limited edition porcelain piece from the Designer's Collection series. It features a mother and child theme, showcasing the bond of motherhood. Handmade in China, this medium-sized figurine stands 6 inches tall and 3.75 inches wide, weighing 9 ounces. With a multicolor design, this collectible item is ideal for display in any room and appeals to teens, boys, girls, and adults alike.
